items.example: I agree with you to some extent, but not completely.
items.exampleTr: Seninle bir dereceye kadar aynı fikirdeyim ama tamamen değil.
items.simple: Yes, but only a little bit. Not all the way.

items.example: I'm not entirely convinced this plan will work.
items.exampleTr: Bu planın işe yarayacağından tam emin değilim.
items.simple: I still have a little doubt in my head about it.
items.note: 'I don't believe it'ten çok daha yumuşak.

items.example: Whether it's worth the money is debatable.
items.exampleTr: Paraya değip değmeyeceği tartışılır.
items.simple: People can have different ideas about it, and nobody is sure.

items.example: She's arguably the best cook in the family.
items.exampleTr: Muhtemelen ailenin en iyi aşçısı o.
items.simple: Many people could say this is true, and they would have good reasons.
items.note: Güçlü bir iddiayı yumuşatır; 'bence de' demeden fikir söyler.

items.example: I'd be inclined to wait a few more days.
items.exampleTr: Birkaç gün daha beklemeye meylederdim.
items.simple: I think I would pick this, but I am not very sure.

items.example: It's debatable whether the new system is any better.
items.exampleTr: Yeni sistemin daha iyi olup olmadığı tartışmalı.
items.simple: Not clear. Some people say yes and some people say no.

items.example: His excuse sounded plausible, so nobody questioned it.
items.exampleTr: Mazereti akla yatkın geldi, kimse sorgulamadı.
items.simple: Something that could easily be true, because it makes sense.

items.example: We've made a tentative plan, but nothing is final yet.
items.exampleTr: Geçici bir plan yaptık ama henüz kesin bir şey yok.
items.simple: Not sure yet. It might change later.

items.example: Honestly, that story sounds a bit far-fetched to me.
items.exampleTr: Dürüst olmak gerekirse bu hikaye bana biraz zorlama geliyor.
items.simple: Very hard to believe, like a story with dragons in your kitchen.

items.example: Whether a film is good is pretty subjective.
items.exampleTr: Bir filmin iyi olup olmadığı oldukça öznel.
items.simple: It comes from what you feel, not from what is true for everyone.

items.example: I'm a bit sceptical about those big promises.
items.exampleTr: O büyük vaatlere biraz şüpheyle bakıyorum.
items.simple: You do not believe something easily. You ask lots of questions first.

items.example: Everyone loves that café, but I think it's overrated.
items.exampleTr: Herkes o kafeyi seviyor ama bence abartılmış.
items.simple: People say it is great, but it is not as good as they say.

items.example: I'm leaning towards taking the second offer.
items.exampleTr: İkinci teklifi kabul etmeye meylediyorum.
items.simple: I have not chosen yet, but I like this one more.

items.example: Money helps, up to a point, but it won't make you happy.
items.exampleTr: Para bir noktaya kadar yardımcı olur ama mutlu etmez.
items.simple: This is true, but only until you reach a certain place.

items.example: That's a fair point, but we don't have the budget.
items.exampleTr: Haklı bir noktaya değindin ama bütçemiz yok.
items.simple: You say the other person is right, and then you tell your own idea.
items.note: Karşı çıkmadan önce karşı tarafı onaylar.

items.example: You can't sit on the fence forever. Pick a side.
items.exampleTr: Sonsuza kadar tarafsız kalamazsın. Bir taraf seç.
items.simple: You do not choose one side or the other, like sitting on a wall.
items.note: Deyim; biraz eleştirel bir tonu olabilir.

items.example: You come across as very confident in meetings.
items.exampleTr: Toplantılarda çok kendine güvenen biri gibi görünüyorsun.
items.simple: This is how other people feel about you when they see you.

items.example: I have a few reservations about the contract.
items.exampleTr: Sözleşme hakkında birkaç çekincem var.
items.simple: You are not fully happy about something. Some worries stay in your head.

items.example: Let me play devil's advocate for a second.
items.exampleTr: Bir saniyeliğine şeytanın avukatlığını yapayım.
items.simple: You say the opposite idea on purpose, so everyone thinks harder.

items.example: My dad holds strong views about politics.
items.exampleTr: Babamın siyaset hakkında güçlü görüşleri var.
items.simple: You know what you think and you will not change it easily.

items.example: The company refused to take a stance on the issue.
items.exampleTr: Şirket konuyla ilgili tavır almayı reddetti.
items.simple: You show everyone which side you are on.

items.en: It's not so much X as Y. It's not so much laziness as fear.
items.tr: Bu daha çok X değil Y. Tembellikten çok korku.
items.example: It's not so much the money as the principle.
items.exampleTr: Mesele para değil, daha çok prensip.
items.simple: This sentence says the second thing is the real reason, not the first.

items.en: If anything, I'd say… If anything, it's too cheap.
items.tr: Bir şey diyecek olsam… Aksine fazla ucuz.
items.example: If anything, I'd say we're being too careful.
items.exampleTr: Bir şey diyecek olsam, fazla temkinliyiz derim.
items.simple: You say the opposite of what people think might be true.

items.en: I wouldn't go so far as to say… I wouldn't go so far as to say it's bad.
items.tr: …demeye kadar varmam. Kötü demeye kadar varmam.
items.example: I wouldn't go so far as to say he's lying.
items.exampleTr: Yalan söylüyor demeye kadar varmam.
items.simple: You are not ready to say something that strong.
